per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must be unique across all records
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
Account_No must be unique (no duplicates allowed)
Name must not be null
Name must be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles like bin, binte, s/o, d/o)
ID_No must not be null
ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
ID_No must not use known non-standard formats identified in data profiling
Race must not be null
Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, or Indian (case-sensitive)
Gender must not be null
Gender must be either Male or Female (case-sensitive)
Age must not be null
Age must be parseable as an integer
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
Age must not be negative
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number with 8 digits (local) or +65 prefix followed by 8 digits
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
Email must not contain known malformed patterns identified in data profiling
Country must not be null
Country must be standardized to 'Singapore' (flag non-standard representations)
Street_Name must not be null
Street_Name must be in Title Case
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
Gender must be consistent with gender-encoding name particles (Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female)
Name must match Acc_Info_dirty.Full_Name for the same S_N (case-insensitive)
ID_No must exactly match Acc_Info_dirty.ID for the same S_N
Account_No must exactly match Acc_Info_dirty.Account_No for the same S_N
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
